fusions.name: Pitched Turf
fusions.desc: Pitches a clod of turf that deals 6 damage. 25% of the damage it deals comes back as healing over the following 6 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Break New Pasture
fusions.desc: Breaks the ground open around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Fodder
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Its healing rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Deep Litter
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
